name: Assia Djebar
shortBio: Algerian historian, postcolonial theorist, and Académie française member whose polyphonic counter-archives excavated Maghrebi women’s oral resistance against both French colonial erasure and postcolonial patriarchy.
centralQuestion: How can a postcolonial woman speak and recover erased ancestral voices through the very language of the colonizer?

keyWorks.title: Fantasia: An Algerian Cavalcade (L'Amour, la fantasia)
keyWorks.description: Counter-archival historiography juxtaposing French colonial military dispatches with Algerian women’s oral memory.

keyWorks.title: Women of Algiers in Their Apartment
keyWorks.description: Deconstructs the Orientalist colonial gaze (Delacroix) and examines women’s solidarity after national independence.
